about: Amy Allen is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Houston, Texas area. Providing legal representation in Texas for a variety of different issues, Amy Allen was selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2026.

After completing undergraduate studies, Amy Allen attended law school. Amy Allen was enrolled at University of Houston Law Center. She earned a juris doctor degree in 2006. Amy Allen was admitted to the practice of law in 2006.

Attorneys like Amy Allen are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Amy Allen represents clients with Family Law issues.
